json_cases.m41_sql:
SELECT event_id, vehicle_id
FROM telemetry_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::numeric >= 100
json_cases.m43_sql:
SELECT event_id, vehicle_id
FROM telemetry_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::NUMERIC >= 100

json_cases.m41_sql: SELECT v.vehicle_id, t.event_at AS latest_event_timestamp, t.payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}' AS engine_temperature FROM vehicles AS v JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vehicle_id) vehicle_id, event_at, payload FROM telemetry_events ORDER BY vehicle_id, event_at DESC, event_id DESC) AS t ON t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id ORDER BY v.vehicle_id
json_cases.m43_sql: SELECT v.vehicle_id, t.event_at AS latest_event_timestamp, (t.payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::NUMERIC AS engine_temperature FROM vehicles AS v JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vehicle_id) vehicle_id, event_at, payload FROM telemetry_events ORDER BY vehicle_id, event_at DESC, event_id DESC) AS t ON t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id ORDER BY v.vehicle_id

json_cases.m41_sql:
SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE (payload #>> '{risk_score}')::numeric >= 70
GROUP BY account_id
json_cases.m43_sql:
SELECT t.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions AS t
WHERE (t.payload #>> '{risk_score}')::NUMERIC >= 70
GROUP BY t.account_id

json_cases.m41_sql:
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS usage_event_count
FROM usage_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{units}')::integer >= 1000
GROUP BY account_id
json_cases.m43_sql:
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS usage_event_count
FROM usage_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{units}')::INTEGER >= 1000
GROUP BY account_id

six_m41_sql_controls.m41_sql:
SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_event_count
FROM vehicles AS v
LEFT JOIN maintenance_events AS m
  ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
 AND m.performed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 12:00:00'
 AND m.performed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 12:00:00'
GROUP BY v.vehicle_id;
six_m41_sql_controls.m43_sql:
SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_event_count
FROM vehicles AS v
LEFT JOIN maintenance_events AS m
  ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
 AND m.performed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29 12:00:00'
 AND m.performed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 12:00:00'
GROUP BY v.vehicle_id

six_m41_sql_controls.m43_sql: SELECT v.vehicle_id, t.event_at AS latest_event_timestamp, (t.payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::NUMERIC AS engine_temperature FROM vehicles AS v JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vehicle_id) vehicle_id, event_at, payload FROM telemetry_events ORDER BY vehicle_id, event_at DESC, event_id DESC) AS t ON t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id ORDER BY v.vehicle_id

six_m41_sql_controls.m41_sql:
SELECT po.warehouse_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) AS received_quantity
FROM purchase_orders AS po
JOIN purchase_order_lines AS pol ON pol.po_id = po.po_id
WHERE po.status = 'open'
GROUP BY po.warehouse_id
six_m41_sql_controls.m43_sql:
SELECT po.warehouse_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) AS received_quantity
FROM purchase_orders AS po
JOIN purchase_order_lines AS pol ON pol.po_id = po.po_id
WHERE po.status = 'open'
GROUP BY po.warehouse_id

six_m41_sql_controls.m41_sql:
SELECT pol.product_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS quantity_ordered_not_yet_received
FROM purchase_order_lines AS pol
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id
GROUP BY pol.product_id
HAVING SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) > 0
six_m41_sql_controls.m43_sql:
SELECT pol.product_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS quantity_ordered_not_yet_received
FROM purchase_order_lines AS pol
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id
GROUP BY pol.product_id
HAVING COUNT(pol.po_line_id) > 0

six_m41_sql_controls.m41_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id
FROM alerts AS a
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
WHERE a.status = 'open'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM watchlist_matches AS wm
    WHERE wm.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND wm.cleared_at IS NULL
  )
six_m41_sql_controls.m43_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id
FROM alerts AS a
WHERE a.status = 'open'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM watchlist_matches AS wm
    WHERE wm.customer_id = a.customer_id
      AND wm.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  );
